question: Should OpenClaw accept a 16 MiB inbound websocket frame cap for every realtime transcription provider in this shared helper?
rationale: Code review verifies the `ws` mechanism and shared owner boundary, but the final compatibility/security tradeoff for rare oversized provider frames is maintainer-owned.

options.title: Accept the 16 MiB cap
options.body: Merge the hardening as written, accepting bounded failures for provider frames above 16 MiB as the desired safety default.

options.title: Adjust the cap before merge
options.body: Ask for a different constant if maintainers know a supported realtime transcription provider legitimately sends frames above 16 MiB.

options.title: Pause for provider evidence
options.body: Hold the PR until provider-specific frame-size documentation or live evidence confirms the chosen cap across supported providers.

recommendation.title: Accept the 16 MiB cap
recommendation.body: Merge the hardening as written, accepting bounded failures for provider frames above 16 MiB as the desired safety default.
